rhacophyton.corrections: Concept inspected: retain open forked three-dimensional scaffold. Reject conspicuous round club/bud tips and overthick tree trunk in generated image. Terminal tips taper without spherical swellings; axis slender. Historical spiral whole-habit concept is not asserted as uniquely settled phyllotaxy.
rhacophyton.limitations: Rhacophyton ceratangium sterile whole-habit educational reconstruction. Andrews and Phillips primary abstract supports bipinnate non-laminate fronds and woody axes. A published secondary historical reconstruction depicts spiral fronds; other literature describes paired rows, so whole-habit/spiral arrangement is explicitly interpretive. Nominal size, green palette and module counts are art choices, not replicated specimen measurements.

sigillaria.corrections: Concept inspected: retain single column, vertical scar rows and simple crown straps. Make crown less broad and scars less embossed than generated palm-like image; separate scars by visible quiet rib lengths, not touching ornamental scales. Do not borrow branching habit from ribless S.brardii. Small basal rhizomorph beginnings only.
sigillaria.limitations: Genus-level single unbranched Rhytidolepis-type ribbed reconstruction, not an asserted exact species specimen. Seward original museum illustrations support leaf-scar morphology; DiMichele2013 primary discussion supports little or no dichotomized crown in Sigillaria. Crown dimensions, selected scar/rib count and six-metre scene scale artistic.

pseudobornia.corrections: Concept inspected: keep open scaffold but avoid a broad tree of only terminal needle tufts. Correct leaf placement to repeated nodal whorls on thin terminal laterals; exactly four leaves per whorl, clearly feather-like deeply divided laminae. Reduce main stem thickness from generated image. No reproductive structures, consistent with deliberately sterile whole-plant concept.
pseudobornia.limitations: Pseudobornia ursina interpretation informed by Rastier2025 primary reappraisal, vegetative description p12-13 and Fig3, fertile interpretation Fig15 also inspected. Primary fossils mostly detached; exact complete outline remains uncertain. Two-metre artistic juvenile whole-habit form rather than claim of mature fossil size. Nominal8cm leaves are source-informed illustrative target, not hard tolerance.

calamites.corrections: Concept inspected: retain jointed hierarchy but greatly reduce oversized star foliage and collar-like node swellings. Make leaf whorls small subordinate details on secondary twigs. Outer bark intentionally quiet because longitudinal ribs on consulted casts describe internal mold/pith preservation, not known external bark.
calamites.limitations: Genus-level vegetative Calamites reconstruction using original university fossil collection stem/Annularia photographs and UCMP description of sphenophyte nodal whorls. Associated foliage morphogenus is not a second asset or synonym. Whole outline, tiers/counts, scale and colors are interpretive; no exact organ species association claimed.
